All — quick CS perspective on acceptance criteria and checkpoint cadence:

- Checkpoint 1 (30d): onboarding completion, integration smoke tests passed, <20% error rate on inference calls, and basic throughput observed.
- Checkpoint 2 (60d): quality acceptance — >90% pass rate on 50-sample eval set per agreed prompts, sustained throughput >=70% of committed baseline for two consecutive weeks.
- Checkpoint 3 (90d): stabilization — less than 2 incidents impacting SLA in prior 30 days, and usage at baseline or above.

Suggest we include a short remediation window (14 days) after failed checkpoint 2 where Redwood provides prioritized engineering support and temporary credits. If remediation fails, the checkpoint triggers either contract renegotiation or the routing credit Marcus described.

Happy to draft a one-page acceptance criteria appendix for the MAP.

— Lauren
